KhAlid ibn Makhlad informed us, Malik told us, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Dinar, on the authority of Ibn Umar ( ), who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: “When one of the Jews greets someone, he only says: ‘As-Samu ‘Alayka.’ Say: ‘Alayka.’”

Sahl ibn Hammad narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, on the authority of Sayyar, who said: I was walking with Thabit al-Bunani, and he passed by some children, so he greeted them. Thabit narrated that he was with Anas, and he passed by some children, so he greeted them. Anas narrated that he was with the Prophet ( ) and he passed by some children, so he greeted them.

Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' informed us, on the authority of Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamza, on the authority of al-Zuhri, who said: Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman narrated to me that Ummul Momineen Aisha ( ), the wife of the Prophet ( ), said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: "O Ummul Momineen Aisha ( ), this is Jibreel ( ) greeting you." She replied ( ) "And upon him be peace, Allah's mercy, and His blessings." She said: He sees what I do not see.

Abdullah ibn Maslama narrated to us, Sulayman (he is Ibn al-Mughirah) narrated to us, from Humayd ibn Hilal, from Abdullah ibn as-Samit, from Abu Dharr ( ), who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) prayed, so I went to him when he had finished his prayer, and I was the first to be greeted with the Islamic greeting. He said: "Peace and mercy of Allah be upon you. Who are you from?" He said: “I said, “From Ghifar. He said: So, he raised his hand. I said to myself: He hates that I belong to Ghifar.

Muhammad ibn Kathir narrated to us, Ja'far ibn Sulayman narrated to us, from Awf, from Abu Raja', from Imran ibn Husayn ( ), who said: A man came to the Prophet ( ) and said, "Peace be upon you." He responded, saying, "Ten." Then a man came and greeted him, and he said, "Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah." He responded, saying, "Twenty." Then a man came and greeted him, saying: “Peace be upon you and the mercy and blessings of Allah.” He responded and said: “Thirty.”

Ishaq informed us, Muadh ibn Hisham told us, my father told me, on the authority of Qatada, on the authority of Al-Hasan, on the authority of Al-Hudayn, on the authority of Al-Muhajir ibn Qunfudh: That he greeted the Prophet ( ) while he was urinating, “and he did not return his greeting until he performed ablution. When he performed ablution, he returned it to him.”

Yahya ibn Bastam informed us, Layth ibn Sa'd narrated to us, on the authority of Yazid ibn Abi Habib, on the authority of Abu al-Khayr, on the authority of Uqbah ibn Amir, who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: "Do not enter upon women." It was said: "O Apostle of Allah, except the in-laws?" He said: "The in-laws mean death." Yahya said: The in-laws mean the husband's relatives.

Muhammad ibn Yusuf and Abu Nu`aym narrated to us, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of Yunus, on the authority of `Amr ibn Sa`id, on the authority of Abu Zur`ah ibn `Amr ibn Jarir, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his grandfather, who said: I asked the Prophet( ) about a sudden glance, and he said: “Avert your gaze.”

Ahmad ibn Khalid informed us, Muhammad (he is Ibn Ishaq) told us, on the authority of Nafi', on the authority of Safiyyah bint Abi Ubayd, on the authority of Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet ( ), who said: The Prophet ( ) was asked about a woman's hem, and he said: "A handspan." I said: "O Apostle of Allah, do their feet show then?" He said: "Then a cubit, no more." Abdullah said: “People say: On the authority of Nafi’, on the authority of Sulayman ibn Yasar.

Muhammad ibn Yusuf informed us, Sufyan told us, on the authority of Mansur, Rib’i ibn Hirash told me, on the authority of his wife, on the authority of a sister of Hudhayfah, who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) addressed us and said: “O women, do you not have the means to adorn yourself with silver? There is no woman among you who adorns herself with gold and shows it off, except that she will be punished for it.” "

Abu Asim informed us, on the authority of Thabit ibn Umarah, on the authority of Ghunaim ibn Qays, on the authority of Abu Musa: “Any woman who applies perfume, then goes out so that her fragrance can be detected, is an adulteress, and every eye is an adulterer.” Abu Asim said: Some of our companions attribute it to the Prophet.

Muhammad ibn Yusuf informed us, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of Mansur, on the authority of Ibrahim, on the authority of Alqamah, on the authority of Abdullah, who said: “Allah has cursed those who tattoo, those who pluck their eyebrows, and those who file their teeth for the sake of beauty, changing Allah’s creation.” News of that reached a woman from Banu Asad called Umm Ya’qub, so she came and said: “I have heard that you cursed such and such.” He said: “Why should I not?” Shall I curse the one whom the Apostle of Allah ( ) cursed, and it is in the Book of Allah? She said: I have read what is between the two covers, and I did not find in it what you say. He said: If you had read it, you would have found it. Didn't you read: “And whatever the Apostle has given you - take; and what he has forbidden you - refrain from. And fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is severe in penalty.” Surah Al-Hashr, Verse 7? She said: “Yes.” He said: He has forbidden it. She said: I see your family doing it. He said: Go in and look. So she went in and looked, but did not see anything of what she needed. He said: If that were the case, I would not have had intercourse with her.

Uthman ibn Muhammad informed us, Zayd ibn al-Hubab informed us, Yahya ibn Ayyub al- Hadrami informed me, Ayyash ibn Abbas al-Himyari informed me, on the authority of Abu al- Husayn al-Hijri, on the authority of Abu Amir, who said: I heard Abu Rayhanah, the companion of the Apostle of Allah ( ) say: The Apostle of Allah ( ) used to forbid ten things: A man having intercourse with another man under one garment, with nothing between them. A woman having intercourse with another woman under one garment, with nothing between them. Plucking, tattooing, plundering, riding tigers, and wearing brocade here on the shoulders and at the bottom of one's clothes. Abdullah said: Abu Amir, a sheikh of theirs. Intercourse means lying down.

Yazid ibn Harun and Wahb ibn Jarir informed us: Hisham al-Dustuwa'i told us, on the authority of Yahya, on the authority of Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas: The Prophet ( ) cursed effeminate men and masculine women and said: "Expel them from your homes." He said: So, the Prophet ( ) sent out so-and-so, and Umar ( ) sent out so-and-so or so-and-so. Abdullah said: So, I am in doubt.

Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak informed us, Malik informed us, on the authority of Abu al-Nadr, on the authority of Zur’ah ibn Abd al-Rahman, on the authority of his father, who was one of the Companions of the Suffah, who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) sat with us and my thigh was uncovered. He said: “Cover yourself. Don’t you know that the thigh is private?”

Ya'la informed us, Al-A'mash told us, on the authority of Amr ibn Murrah, on the authority of Sali m ibn Abi Al-Ja'd, who said: Some women from Homs came to Aisha to ask her a fatwa. She said: Perhaps you are among the women who enter the baths? They said: Yes. She said: I heard the Apostle of Allah ( ) say: “There is no woman who takes off her clothes anywhere other than her husband’s house, except that she has torn apart what is between her and Allah.” Abu Muhammad said: Ubaydullah informed us, on the authority of Isra’il, on the authority of Mansur, on the authority of Salim, on the authority of Abu al-Malih, on the authority of Aisha ( ), this hadith.

Musaddad informed us, Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal told us, Ubaydullah told us, on the authority of Nafi’, on the authority of Ibn Umar ( ), who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: “A man should not make his brother get up from his seat and then sit in it but rather make room and spread out.”

Ahmad ibn Abdullah narrated to us, Zuhair narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to us, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: “If one of you, or a man, stands up from his seat and then returns to it, he has more right to it.”

Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi informed us, Shu'bah told us, Abu Ishaq told us, on the authority of al- Bara': The Apostle of Allah ( ) passed by some sitting people from the Ansar, and he said: "If you must do something, then guide the way, spread peace, and help the oppressed." Shu`bah said: Abu Ishaq did not hear this hadith from Al-Bara ( ).

Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf informed us, Sufyan told us, he said: I heard Al-Zuhri narrating, on the authority of Abbad ibn Tamim, on the authority of his uncle, he said: I saw the Apostle of Allah ( ) lying down in the mosque, placing one of his legs on the other.

Ubaydullah ibn Musa informed us, on the authority of al-A’mash, on the authority of Abu Wa’il, on the authority of Abdullah, who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: “If there are three of you, two of you should not whisper to each other in private to the exclusion of their companion, for that will make him sad.”

Ya`la ibn `Ubayd narrated to us, Hajjaj narrated to us, meaning Ibn Dinar, on the authority of Abu Hashim, on the authority of Rufa`i`: Abu al-Aliyah, on the authority of Abu Barzah al-Aslami, who said: When he was in the latter part of the year, whenever the Apostle of Allah ( ) sat in a gathering and wanted to stand up, he would say: “Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. I bear witness that there is no Allah but You.” I seek Your forgiveness, and I repent to You.” They said: “O Apostle of Allah, you are now saying things that you did not say before.” He said: “This is an expiation for what happens in gatherings.”

Sa'id ibn 'Amir informed us, on the authority of Shu'bah, on the authority of Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Laila, on the authority of his brother 'Isa, on the authority of his father, 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Laila, on the authority of Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, on the authority of the Prophet( ) who said: "The one who sneezes should say: 'Praise be to Allah in every situation.' The one who says, 'May Allah have mercy on you' should say: 'May Allah have mercy on you,' and the person should respond: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.

Ahmad ibn Abdullah informed us, Zuhair narrated from Sulayman from Anas, who said: Two men sneezed in the presence of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace. He said, "May Allah have mercy on you," or he said, "May Allah have mercy on you," to one of them, but not to the other. It was said to him, "O Apostle of Allah, you said, "May Allah have mercy on you," to this one, but not to the other. He said, "This one praised Allah, and this one did not praise Allah." Abdullah said: Sulayman is Al-Taymi.

Abu al-Walid informed us, Ikrimah (he is Ibn Ammar) told us, he said: Iyas ibn Salamah told me, he said: My father told me, he said: A man sneezed in the presence of the Prophet ( ), so he said: “May Allah have mercy on you.” Then he sneezed again, so he said: “The man has a cold.”

Sa'id ibn 'Amir informed us, on the authority of Shu'bah, on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, on the authority of his father, who said: 'A'ishah ( ) said: "We had a garment on which there were pictures, so I placed it in front of the Prophet ( ) while he was praying. He forbade me, or she said: He disliked it. So, I made it into a pillow."

Abu al-Nu'man informed us, 'Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad informed us, 'Umar ( )a ibn al-Qa'qa' informed us, al-Harith al-'Ukli informed us, on the authority of Abu Zur'ah ibn 'Amr ibn Jarir, on the authority of 'Abdullah ibn Nujayy, on the authority of 'Ali ( ): The Prophet( ) said: "An angel does not enter a house in which there is a dog, nor an image, nor a person in a state of ritual impurity."

Abu al-Walid narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, he said: Adi ibn Thabit informed me, he said: I heard Abdullah ibn Yazid narrating, on the authority of Abu Mas'ud al-Badri, on the authority of the Prophet ( ) that he said: "When a Muslim spends on his family, hoping for a reward from Allah, then it is considered charity for him."

Abu al-Nu'man informed us, Thabit ibn Yazid told us, he said: Asim al-Ahwal told us, on the authority of Muwarriq, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Ja'far, he said: "Whenever the Apostle of Allah ( ) returned, he would meet me and al-Hasan or al-Husayn. He said: And I think he said: al-Hasan. So, he carried me in front of him, and al-Hasan behind him, until we arrived in Medina, and we were on The animal on which the Prophet ( ) rode.

Sa`id ibn Sulayman informed us, on the authority of Ishaq ibn Yahya ibn Talhah, on the authority of al-Musayyab ibn Rafi` and Ma`bad ibn Khalid, on the authority of `Abdullah ibn Yazid al- Khatmi, who was the governor of Kufa. He said: We came to Qays ibn Sa`d ibn `Ubadah in his house, and the mu`adhdhin called for prayer. We said to Qays: Get up and lead us in prayer. He said: I have not been So that I may lead people in prayer over whom I am not a leader. A man who was not lower than him, called Abdullah ibn Hanzala ibn al-Ghaseel, said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: “A man has more right to the front of his mount, the front of his bed, and to lead the prayer in his saddle.” At that, Qais ibn Sa`d said: “O so-and-so, to a slave of his: Get up and lead them in prayer.”

Ubaydullah ibn Musa informed us, on the authority of Usamah ibn Zayd, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Hamza ibn Amr al-Aslami, who said: His father accompanied the Apostle of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace. He said: I heard my father say: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: “On the top of every camel is a devil, so when you mount it, say the name of Allah and do not shorten your mounts.” Your needs.

Uthman ibn Muhammad informed us, Shababah ibn Sawwar told us, Layth ibn Sa'd told us, on the authority of Yazid ibn Abi Habib, on the authority of Sahl ibn Mu'adh ibn Anas, on the authority of his father, who was one of the Companions of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: "Ride these animals in good condition, and do not use them as mounts." Abdullah bin Salih told us, on the authority of Al-Layth,... except that he differed from Shababah in something.

Khalid ibn Makhlad informed us, Malik told us, from Sumayy, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: “Travel is a form of torment that prevents one of you from sleeping, eating, and drinking. So, when one of you has satisfied his need from his destination, let him hasten to return to his family.”

Muslim ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, Sa'id ibn Abi Ka'b narrated to us: Abu al-Hasan al-'Abdi narrated to us, saying: Musa ibn Maysarah al-'Abdi narrated to me, on the authority of Anas ibn Malik, who said: A man came to the Prophet ( ) and said to him: O Prophet of Allah, I want to travel. He asked him: "When?" He said: "Tomorrow, Allah willing." He said: So, he came to him, took him by the hand, and said to him: “In the protection of Allah, and under His care. May Allah provide you with piety, forgive your sin, and guide you to goodness wherever you seek or wherever you go.” Sa`id was unsure about one of the two words.

Yazid ibn Harun informed us, Asim - he is Al-Ahwal - informed us, he said: Shu'bah confirmed me, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Sarjis, he said: Whenever the Prophet ( ) traveled, he would say: "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, the gloom of returning, the loss of sight after being awake, the supplication of the oppressed, and an evil sight among the family and money.

Yahya ibn Hassan informed us, Hammad ibn Salamah told us, on the authority of Abu al-Zubayr, on the authority of Ali ibn Abdullah al-Bariqi, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Umar ( ): Whenever the Apostle of Allah ( ) traveled and mounted his mount, he would say Allahu Akbar three times and say: “Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could not have had it by ourselves. {13} And indeed, to our Lord we will return.” 14} Surah Az-Zukhruf, Verses 13-14 #. O Allah, I ask You in this journey of mine for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make the journey easy for us, and shorten for us the distance of the earth. O Allah, You are the Companion in travel and the Guardian over the family. O Allah, accompany us in our journey and replace us with good for our family.

Ahmad ibn Abdullah told us, Abu Zubayd told us, on the authority of Husayn, on the authority of Salim, on the authority of Jabir, who said: “When we ascended, we would say ‘Allahu Akbar’, and when we descended, we would say ‘Subhan Allah’.”

Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak informed us, Malik told us, on the authority of Nafi’, on the authority of Salim, on the authority of Abu al-Jarrah, the freed slave of Umm Habibah, on the authority of Umm Habibah, on the authority of the Prophet ( ) who said: “The caravan that has a bell is not accompanied by the angels.”

Ahmad ibn Abdullah informed us, Zuhair told us, Suhayl ibn Abi Salih told us, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, on the authority of the Prophet ( ) who said: “The angels do not accompany a group in which there is a dog or a bell.”

Sulayman ibn Harb informed us, Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Muhallab, from Imran ibn Husayn: The Prophet ( ) was on a journey and heard a curse. He said, "What is this?" They said, "So-and-so cursed her mount." He said, "Leave it alone, for it is cursed." So, they left it alone. Imran said: It is as if I see her as a white camel.

Ya`la narrated to us, Al-A`mash narrated to us, on the authority of Abu Salih, on the authority of Abu Sa`id, who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: “A woman should not travel for a period of three days or more unless she is accompanied by her father, her brother, her husband, or a mahram from among them.”

Al-Haytham ibn Jamil informed us, Asim ibn Muhammad al-Umari informed us, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ibn Umar ( ), who said: The Prophet ( ) said: “If people knew what is in being alone, no rider would ever travel alone at night.”

Ahmad ibn Ishaq and Affan informed us: Wahib told us: Muhammad ibn Ajlan told us, on the authority of Ya`qub ibn `Abdullah ibn al-Ashja`, on the authority of Sa`id ibn al-Musayyib, on the authority of Sa`d ibn Malik, on the authority of Khawlah bint Hakim, who said: I heard the Apostle of Allah ( ) say: “If one of you, when he enters a house, says: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created. Nothing will harm him in that abode until he departs from it.”

Abu Asim informed us, on the authority of Uthman ibn Sa'd, on the authority of Anas ibn Malik ( ): "Whenever the Prophet ( ) stopped at a place, he would not leave it until he had prayed two rak'ahs or bid farewell to the place with two rak'ahs." Abdullah said: Uthman ibn Sa'd is weak.

Yahya ibn Hassan informed us, Hammad ibn Salamah told us, on the authority of Abu al-Zubayr, on the authority of Ali ibn Abdullah al-Bariqi, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Umar ( ): When the Prophet ( ) returned from a journey, he would say: “We have returned, Allah willing, repentant, worshipping and praising our Lord.”

Abu al-Walid informed us, Shu`bah told us, he said: Abu Ishaq told us, he said: I heard al-Bara’ ibn `Azib say: The Apostle of Allah ( ) commanded a man, when he went to bed, to say: “O Allah, I submit myself to You, I direct my face to You, I entrust my affair to You, and I seek refuge in You, out of desire and fear of You.” There is no refuge or escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You revealed and Your Prophet whom You sent. If he dies, he dies in a state of fitrah.

Abu al-Nu'man informed us, Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, on the authority of Ubayd Allah ibn Umar ( ), on the authority of Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: "When one of you goes to his bed, let him shake out his bed with the inside of his garment, for he does not know what he left behind in it, and let him say: 'O Allah, with You I lay down my side.'" And with You I raise it. O Allah, if You hold my soul, then forgive it, and if You release it, then protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.

Yazid ibn Harun informed us, Al-Awwam ibn Hawshab informed us, he said: Amr ibn Murrah informed me, on the authority of Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Laila, on the authority of Ali ( ), he said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) came to us until he placed his foot between me and Fatimah, and he taught us what to say when we go to bed: “Thirty-three glorifications of Allah, and thirty-three Praise be to Allah, and thirty-four Takbirs.” Ali ( ) said: “I have never left it after that.” A man said to him: “Not even on the night of Siffin?” He said: “Not even on the night of Siffin.”

Muhammad ibn Yusuf informed us, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of Abd al-Malik ibn Umair, on the authority of Rib'i ibn Hirash, on the authority of Hudhayfah, who said: Whenever the Prophet ( ) would wake up, he would say: "Praise be to Allah, who has given us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection."

Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Hizami informed us, al-Walid ibn Muslim informed us, al-Awza’i informed us, he said: Umair ibn Hani’ al-Ansi informed me, he said: Junada ibn Abi Umayya informed me, he said: Ubadah ibn al-Samit informed me, on the authority of the Prophet( ) who said: “Whoever gets up at night and says: ‘There is no Allah but Allah alone, with no partner,’ To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent. Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Allah, and Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power nor strength save with Allah. Then he said: “My Lord, forgive me,” or he said: Then he supplicated, and his supplication was answered. If he resolved to do so, performed ablution, and then prayed, his prayer was accepted.

Muhammad ibn Yusuf informed us, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of Salamah ibn Kuhayl, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abza, on the authority of his father, who said: Whenever the Prophet ( ) woke up, he would say: “We have woken up upon the nature of Islam, the word of sincerity, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, and the way of our father Abraham, a pure Muslim.”

Sa'id ibn 'Amir informed us, on the authority of Shu'bah, on the authority of Ya'la ibn 'Ata', on the authority of 'Amr ibn 'Asim, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, who said: Abu Bakr said: O Apostle of Allah, instruct me to do something that I may say in the morning and in the evening. He said: “Say: ‘O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Lord of all things and their Master, I bear witness that there is no Allah but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his polytheism.’” He said: “Say it when you wake up, when you go to bed at night, and when you lie down to sleep.”

Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Muqri’ informed us, Saeed ibn Abi Ayyub narrated to us, on the authority of Abu Marhum, on the authority of Sahl ibn Mu’adh ibn Anas, on the authority of his father, who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: “Whoever puts on a garment and says: ‘Praise be to Allah who clothed me in this and provided for me without any strength or power from me,’ his previous sins will be forgiven.”

Abdullah ibn Maslamah told us, Sulayman told us, meaning Ibn Bilal, on the authority of Rabi’ah, on the authority of Abd al-Malik ibn Sa’id, on the authority of Abu Humayd or Abu Usayd, who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: “When one of you enters the mosque, let him say: ‘O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.’ And when he leaves, let him say: ‘O Allah, I ask You for Your grace

Yazid ibn Harun informed us, Azhar ibn Sinan informed us, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Wasi’, who said: I came to Mecca and met my brother Salim ibn Abdullah there. He told me, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his grandfather, that the Prophet ( ) said: “Whoever enters the marketplace and says: ‘There is no Allah but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is ever- living.’” He does not die, in His hand is goodness, and He is competent over all things. Allah will write for him a million good deeds, erase from him a million bad deeds, and raise him a thousand thousand degrees.” He said: “So I went to Khurasan and met Qutaybah ibn Muslim and said: ‘I have come to you with a gift.’ I told him about it, and he would ride in his procession, come to the market, stand up, say it, and then go back.”

Sa`id ibn `Amir informed us, on the authority of Hisham, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sirin, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: “Name yourselves by my name, and do not use my kunya.”

Affan ibn Muslim narrated to us, Hisham narrated to us, Dawud ibn Amr informed us, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Abi Zakariya al-Khuza'i, on the authority of Abu al-Darda', who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: "You will be called on the Day of Resurrection by your names and the names of your fathers, so choose good names."

Muhammad ibn Kathir informed us, Ubaydullah ibn Umar informed us, on the authority of Nafi’, on the authority of Ibn Umar ( ), who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: “The names most beloved to Allah are Abdullah and Abd al-Rahman.

Zakariya ibn Adi informed us, Mu’tamir told us, on the authority of Ar-Rukayn, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Samura: The Prophet ( ) “forbade us to name our slaves four names: Aflah, Nafi’, Rabah, and Yasar.”

Hajjaj ibn Minhal narrated to us, Hammad - he is Ibn Salamah - narrated to us, on the authority of Ubayd Allah, on the authority of Nafi’, on the authority of Ibn Umar ( ): Umm Asim was called Asiyah, so the Prophet ( ) named her Jamilah.

Musaddad narrated to us, Yahya ibn Sa`id narrated to us, Shu`bah narrated to us, `Ata` ibn Abi Maymunah narrated to us, on the authority of Abu Rafi`, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, who said: Zaynab’s name was Barrah, but the Prophet ( ) named her Zaynab.

Yazid ibn Harun informed us, Shu'bah informed us, on the authority of Abd al-Malik ibn Umair, on the authority of Rib'i ibn Hirash, on the authority of Tufail, the brother of Aisha, who said: A man from among the polytheists said to a man from among the Muslims: What good people you are, were it not that you say: What Allah wills and what Muhammad wills. The Prophet ( ) heard this and said: “Do not say, ‘What Allah wills and Muhammad wills,’ but say, ‘What Allah wills, then Muhammad wills.’”

Yazid ibn Harun informed us, Muhammad - he is Ibn Ishaq - informed us, on the authority of Salih ibn Ibrahim, on the authority of Abd al-Rahman al-A'raj, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: "Do not call a vineyard a vineyard. Indeed, a vineyard is a Muslim man."

Abu Asim narrated to us, on the authority of Abdullah bin Ubaid, on the authority of Anas, who said: A young boy was driving the wives of the Prophet ( ) and he said: “O Anjasha, take it easy. You are being driven with the glass vessels.”

Yazid ibn Harun informed us, Bahz ibn Hakim informed us, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his grandfather, who said: I heard the Apostle of Allah ( ) say: “Woe to the one who speaks and lies to make people laugh. Woe to him! Woe to him!”

Muhammad ibn Isa informed us, Abdah ibn Sulayman told us, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ishaq, on the authority of Yaqub ibn Utbah, on the authority of Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: The Prophet ( ) confirmed the truth of Umayyah ibn Abi al- Salt in two verses of poetry, and he said: A man with a bull under his right foot, and an eagle for the other, and a lion lying in wait. So, the Prophet ( ) said: Allah's Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) said: "He has spoken the truth." He said: "And the sun rises every last night red, and its color becomes ruddy." The Prophet ( ) said: "He has spoken the truth." Someone said: "She refuses, and she does not rise to us among her Apostles except to be punished or flogged." The Prophet (may peace and blessings be upon him) said: "He has spoken the truth."

Abu Asim informed us, on the authority of Ibn Jurayj, on the authority of Ziyad, who is Ibn Sa’d, who said: He informed me that Ibn Shihab informed him, on the authority of Abu Bakr Ibn Abd al-Rahman Ibn Hisham, on the authority of Marwan Ibn al-Hakam, on the authority of Abd al- Rahman Ibn al-Aswad Ibn Abd Yaghuth, on the authority of Ubayy Ibn Ka’b, on the authority of the Prophet ( ) who said: “Indeed, some poetry wisdom "

Ubaydullah ibn Musa informed us, Hanzala told us, on the authority of Salim, on the authority of Ibn Umar ( ), who said: The Apostle of Allah ( ) said: “For one of you to have his stomach filled with pus or blood is better than for it to be filled with poetry.”
